name: GTK 3 Demo
summary: GTK 3's demos: its widgets and APIs at work, every widget in every state, and its icons

stages.name: icons
build: for app in gtk-demo/gtk3-demo widget-factory/gtk3-widget-factory; do d=demos/${app%/*}/data; n=${app#*/}; sh zigsaw/png2ico.sh "$PREFIX/$n.ico" 16:$d/16x16/$n.png 24:$d/24x24/$n.png 32:$d/32x32/$n.png 48:$d/48x48/$n.png 256:$d/256x256/$n.png || exit 1; done
